task:
Execute ED-Finder Stage 27A — Spatial Platform Contract and Audit.

MISSION
Establish the authoritative product, architecture, data-readiness, migration and governance contracts for ED-Finder's next-generation spatial platform before any new Babylon runtime implementation begins. This is principally documentation/audit/contract work.

MANDATORY START
1. Work from current origin/main.
2. Read docs/ROADMAP.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/development/agent-prompt-contract.md, current Stage 25/26 map contracts, current map code/tests, and the August 16 Babylon plan.
3. Run the repository's strict state-resolution gate before changes. If it fails, stop and report blocked/partial. Do not bypass it.
4. Audit sibling repos colonisation-research-engine (CRE) and colony-planning-engine (CPE) where available, following their repository policies.
5. Do not access or write production. V3 is live; V2 has been backed up/decommissioned. Production database coverage may only be measured if an already-authorized read-only path exists. Otherwise produce SELECT-only audit queries and mark coverage unknown.

NON-GOALS / HARD STOPS
- No Babylon dependency upgrade.
- No Babylon runtime implementation.
- No production map behavior change.
- Do not delete current R3F/Three.js production map.
- Do not restore the deleted/unreviewed Babylon attempt.
- No System Map renderer yet.
- No CRE mechanics changes.
- No CPE mechanics implementation.
- No production DB writes.
- No V2 archive/backup changes.
- No deploy.
- No merge to main.
- No PR unless explicitly requested later.
- Stop after Stage 27A; do not begin 27B.

HISTORICAL TRUTH
Preserve Stage 26 history exactly: Stage 26 requirements -> equal renderer bakeoff -> R3F/Three.js selected -> R3F foundation delivered -> R3F production cutover completed -> product scope later expanded materially -> renderer requirements changed -> Babylon selected for broader spatial-platform headroom. Never claim Babylon won Stage 26, R3F was a failure, or Three.js was simply broken.

PRODUCT NORTH STAR
"If Frontier's Galaxy Map and ED-Finder had a child" — familiar Elite-style spatial interaction with ED-Finder identity, without copying Frontier assets/code/artwork. Base Galaxy experience must be excellent with ED-Finder overlays off.
Core principle: THE MAP IS THE CONSTANT; INFORMATION CHANGES AROUND IT.
Presets/layer combinations may include REALISTIC, FINDER, COLONISATION, POWERPLAY, EXPLORATION, ROUTES while preserving camera/selection/spatial context.

ONE SPATIAL PLATFORM
Finder / CRE / CPE / Exploration / Powerplay / Routes -> SpatialContribution adapters -> renderer-neutral SpatialSceneContract -> MapRuntime -> GalaxyScene or SystemScene -> BabylonMapRuntime -> LayerManager -> GPU.
Domain/feature code MUST NOT import Babylon.
React owns app/domain orchestration, routing, panels, accessible DOM UI, keyboard/text.
Babylon owns long-lived spatial scene, GPU resources, scene layers, camera implementation, picking/projection/transitions.
Mechanics remain CRE-owned; planning remains CPE-owned; ED-Finder orchestrates/presents; Babylon renders.

UPDATED MAP/PLANNER BOUNDARY
Stage 27 deliberately supersedes the old global "secondary Explore only / no planner-map fusion" restriction.
New rule: spatial platform may participate across Explore -> Inspect -> Plan -> Review where spatial interaction is useful.
Colony Planner/Cockpit remains canonical detailed Build Plan workspace/persistence owner unless later explicitly changed.
Map may show/compare CPE plans, select proposed locations and initiate explicit planning actions, but:
- renderer owns no planning logic or Elite mechanics,
- no silent Build Plan mutation,
- no silent Preview execution,
- planned/inferred/schematic state never appears as existing fact.

FOUR PRIMARY ARCHITECTURE STRESS TESTS
1. Finder
2. Colonisation
3. Exploration
4. System Map

GALAXY REQUIREMENTS TO RECORD
True Elite coordinates, real 3D Milky Way form, excellent top-down and restrained tilt, pan/orbit/zoom, ED-like reference grid, useful Galaxy-Map-like stars, selection/reference treatment, semantic labels, search/fly-to, picking, routes, regions, semantic zoom, ambient dust/nebula/background that never affects factual gameplay data.
Semantic zoom: wide aggregate; regional real systems/important systems; local colonisation/routes/infrastructure/ranges; System as separate scale/scene. Use hysteresis.

FINDER
Existing Finder filters/scores drive spatial results. Matching systems illuminate; score can affect prominence; irrelevant systems recede; selected/highlight/cluster systems guaranteed; score breakdown accessible; map context/viewport/reference can feed Finder. Renderer never calculates Development Score.

COLONISATION
Future spatial presentation can show authoritative candidates, valid/invalid state, expansion ranges, existing/planned colonies, infrastructure, relationships, alternate paths, comparisons, clusters, blockers and route implications. Renderer never invents mechanics. Explicit actions may include Open System, Enter System, Set Reference, Find Around Here, Colonisation Analysis, Compare, Plan From Here, Systems Within..., Show Cluster, Plot Route.

EXPLORATION IS FIRST-CLASS
Do not reduce exploration to visitedSystem:boolean.
One underlying personal exploration record must contribute at Galaxy/system scale and System/body scale.
Audit existing visit, Scan, FSS, DSS mapping, first discoveries/mapping where retained, biological/organic/Codex events, timestamps and chronology.
Support future "What did I miss?", expedition history/playback, visited-but-incomplete, scanned-not-mapped, bio incomplete, unvisited pockets near prior routes, Finder x Exploration.
Completion must be explainable facts (e.g. 8 known bodies, 7 scanned, 4 mapped), not an opaque universal score.

SYSTEM MAP
First-class architecture requirement now; implementation later.
Journey: Galaxy -> select system -> Enter System -> 3D System Map -> select body/facility -> Astronomy / Exploration / Colonisation / Infrastructure / CRE Evidence / CPE Planning -> return to exact meaningful Galaxy state.
System visual targets where data supports: stars/spectral colors, planets, moons, rings, atmospheres, body classes, landability, stations/outposts/settlements/facilities, existing colony infrastructure, planned infrastructure, exploration state.
Do NOT use literal astronomical scale; define semantic display scaling while retaining factual measurements in UI.
Never invent current orbital positions. If present-time phase is unsupported, use deterministic schematic placement.

TRUTH / REPRESENTATION CLASSES
Define at least:
- AUTHORITATIVE factual
- DERIVED analytical
- PLANNED/HYPOTHETICAL
- SCHEMATIC/UNCERTAIN
- AMBIENT/DECORATIVE
Unknown must remain unknown. Decorative visuals never become mechanics facts.

BODY IDENTITY
Audit and formalize canonical system-scoped identity conceptually BodyRef { systemId64, bodyId }. Do not use display name as primary key and do not assume bare BodyID is globally unique. Audit joins across ED-Finder body data, exploration, CRE and infrastructure. Unresolved joins stay unresolved.

SYSTEM FIDELITY
Document:
S0 System only
S1 Stellar
S2 Body hierarchy
S3 Orbital/ring detail
S4 Infrastructure
S5 Digital Twin
Render highest justified fidelity; per-property truth/provenance remains explicit.

SYSTEM MAP DATA-READINESS AUDIT
Distinguish schema support vs real population vs trustworthy provenance vs API exposure.
Inventory system IDs/coords; BodyID/name/parent; body class/radius/mass/gravity/temp/pressure/atmosphere/composition/volcanism/landable/terraformability/materials; stellar class/radius/mass/luminosity/age/magnitude; distance/orbital period/semi-major axis/eccentricity/inclination/ascending node/argument of periapsis/mean anomaly/epoch; rings tri-state/multiple bands/class/inner/outer/provenance/confidence; stations identity/type/body association/lane/confidence/source/distance/services/economy/settlements/exact coords if any; exploration body-level data/timestamps.
If safe read-only V3 coverage cannot be queried, create a SELECT-only production-data-coverage query pack. Never guess.

CRE DIGITAL TWIN
Audit actual CRE ontology/contracts. Target integration: System Map = spatial truth/orientation; Digital Twin = state/reasoning/history/provenance/uncertainty layered onto it. Audit system/body hierarchy, FacilityInstance/body links, slots, dependencies, capabilities, commodities, lifecycle/construction, market/logistics, predictions vs observations, evidence/confidence/contradictions/history. Do not create a separate competing Digital Twin map.

CPE
Audit actual current CPE state/contracts. Preserve CPE as planning owner. Reserve spatial contribution support for chosen plan, proposed facilities, sequencing, alternatives, blocked/rejected options, dependencies/comparison. Do not invent missing CPE mechanics.

BABYLON TECHNICAL DIRECTION TO PIN (NO IMPLEMENTATION IN 27A)
- modern Babylon 9-class direction, not old Babylon 6 plan;
- modular/tree-shakeable @babylonjs/core-style imports rather than monolithic babylonjs where practical;
- WebGPU first, WebGL2 fallback;
- investigate/use Large World Rendering / high precision rather than arbitrary application worldScale; canonical CPU coords remain actual Elite light-years;
- stars as instanced camera-facing quads/billboards/custom buffers, NOT PointsCloudSystem/gl_PointSize and NOT one mesh per star;
- custom semantic renderer-neutral camera, not blindly ArcRotateCamera;
- long-lived runtime, dirty/demand rendering when idle;
- typed SoA/buffers; React does not rebuild GPU arrays every render;
- central PickingService; benchmark built-in instance picking vs GPU ID buffer vs CPU spatial index + GPU confirm;
- worker-ready, main-thread-first unless profiling justifies off-thread;
- resource rebuild/recovery;
- telemetry for backend/frame/visible count/draw calls/resources/buffer bytes/recovery.
Verify modern Babylon specifics against current authoritative docs/package ecosystem before recording them as final.

STAGE 26 INHERITANCE
Create docs/colonisation-redesign/stage-27a-stage26-inheritance-matrix.md.
Classify relevant behavior/contracts as KEEP, EXPAND, SUPERSEDED, HISTORICAL_ONLY with actual file/test evidence. Cover camera, scene boundary, regions, clusters, routes, Finder, Compare, saved/evidence, System Detail, Planner handoff, exploration, Powerplay, selection/highlight guarantees, overlap handling, bounded visibility/responses, fixtures, accessibility, browser support, performance, recovery, rollback/cutover.

THREE-REPO CAPABILITY INVENTORY
Create docs/colonisation-redesign/stage-27a-spatial-capability-inventory.md.
For each spatial concept record owner, actual source file/API/schema, implementation state, truth/provenance, spatial relevance, gap, Stage 27 consumer.

SYSTEM MAP DATA MATRIX
Create docs/colonisation-redesign/stage-27a-system-map-data-readiness.md with columns like Property | Source | Owner | Stored? | Exposed? | Coverage | Freshness | Truth class | Current API/path | Rendering implication | Stage needed. Use AUTHORITATIVE / DERIVED / PLANNED / SCHEMATIC / AMBIENT / UNAVAILABLE / UNKNOWN_COVERAGE.

PRODUCT CONTRACT
Create docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-product-contract.md covering north star, map constant, Galaxy/System/Digital-Twin scales, base experience, semantic zoom, truth classes, presets/layers, Finder/Colonisation/Exploration/Powerplay/routes, multiselect/spatial query, Galaxy<->System, System Map semantic scaling/orbit truth, S0-S5, CRE/CPE, accessibility/reliability/performance, non-goals and acceptance.

ARCHITECTURE DECISION
Create docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-architecture-decision.md covering accurate history, greenfield Babylon renderer/brownfield ED-Finder product, one spatial platform, ownership/dependency boundaries, renderer-neutral contracts/contributions, LY coords/Large World, camera, WebGPU/WebGL2, Babylon modernization, billboard stars, typed arrays, truth vs ambience, LOD/backend, picking, labels, command/event runtime, worker readiness, render cadence, lifecycle/telemetry/recovery, SystemScene, CRE/CPE, Exploration, data readiness, fixtures, bakeoff/cutover, rejected alternatives/consequences.

CONTRACT SKELETONS
Define renderer-neutral architecture for SpatialSceneContract, GalaxySceneContract, SystemSceneContract, SpatialContribution, CameraState, SystemCameraState, RepresentationClass, RuntimeCommand, RuntimeEvent, LayerContract, SpatialTarget, BodyRef, facility reference, OrbitalDescriptor, RingDescriptor, BodyVisualDescriptor, InfrastructureAttachment. Prefer docs/type sketches; inert TS only if repo convention clearly warrants it. No Babylon/Three types and no runtime wiring.

GOVERNANCE UPDATES
1. docs/ROADMAP.md: establish Stage 27 as current programme and remove stale "secondary Explore only / planner-map fusion prohibited / narrow Aug16 plan is current" authority. Programme:
27A Spatial Platform Contract and Audit
27B Babylon 9 Runtime Workbench
27C Elite-Familiar Galaxy Baseline
27D Real-System Streaming and Interaction
27E Stage26 Capability Parity
27F ED-Finder Spatial Workflows
27G Galaxy Bakeoff and Cutover
27H System Scene Data and Rendering Contract
27I 3D System Map
27J Colonised-System Infrastructure
27K CPE Planning and CRE Digital Twin
27L Advanced Spatial Workflows
27A authorizes 27B only.
2. CLAUDE.md: align with ROADMAP; Stage26 complete/history; R3F stays production baseline/rollback until Babylon earns cutover; Stage27A current; no runtime authorized; updated map/planner boundary.
3. docs/colonisation-redesign/README.md: make Stage27A/current authority obvious while preserving Stage26 historical references.
4. docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-16-babylon-js-map-redesign.md: DO NOT delete/rewrite; add prominent historical/superseded notice explaining Babylon6/worldScale/point-cloud/narrow replacement plan is no longer authoritative and must not be executed wholesale.
5. .claude-session-context.md: retire/remove/replace stale 2026-08-15 R3F LOD debug instructions according to repo convention so they no longer misdirect agents.
6. CHANGES.md: record governance/contracts only, no false runtime claim.

TEST / ACCEPTANCE INHERITANCE
Document Stage26 tests as REUSE/ADAPT/REPLACE/HISTORICAL. Future Galaxy benchmark expectations: 20k/40k production-like, 100k stress, 500k torture, 1m extreme diagnostic. Cover top-down/pitched, pan/zoom, LOD/hysteresis, stale/empty/truncated/error, selection/highlight/routes/clusters/presets, DPR/resize, accessibility/reduced motion, WebGPU/WebGL2 and recovery. Determine current authoritative browser/release lane from repo, not old assumptions.

SYSTEM FIXTURES
Document deterministic future fixtures: simple single-star, binary, multiple-star, moon-rich, ring-rich, exploration-rich, colonised, incomplete-data, schematic-orbit, CPE planning, CRE Digital Twin. Truth tests must prove unknown rings != no rings; planned != built; schematic position not authoritative; unresolved associations not forced; missing hierarchy not invented; ambient visuals do not become facts; personal exploration not universal truth; display-scaled radius does not overwrite physical radius.

VALIDATION
Use proportional checks for docs/contracts/governance plus any required repo hygiene/consistency gates. Run targeted TypeScript only if inert TS contracts are added. Do not run huge unrelated suites for optics unless repository policy requires it. Do not skip mandatory gates.

PARALLELISM
Use independent agents/workers for ED-Finder, CRE and CPE audits where useful, but one integration owner must serialise authoritative governance/doc edits. Avoid colliding edits to ROADMAP/CLAUDE/contracts.

EXPECTED FILES
- docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-product-contract.md
- docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-architecture-decision.md
- docs/colonisation-redesign/stage-27a-stage26-inheritance-matrix.md
- docs/colonisation-redesign/stage-27a-spatial-capability-inventory.md

- historical/superseded notice in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-16-babylon-js-map-redesign.md
- stale .claude-session-context.md retired/replaced appropriately
- CHANGES.md
- SELECT-only production data coverage query pack if actual safe read-only coverage cannot be established.

EVIDENCE DISCIPLINE
Every material audit claim should point to current repo/path/symbol/API/schema/test/contract; use commit SHAs where helpful. Record conflicts rather than silently resolve them. Mark unknowns unknown.

FINAL REPORT
End with:
- Completed
- Important discoveries
- Production-data findings
- Conflicts corrected
- Risks
- Genuine open owner decisions only
- Stage27B readiness = READY / READY_WITH_EXPLICIT_CONDITIONS / BLOCKED with reasons.
Do not start 27B.
